questions.text: In a neural network, what does a weight represent?
questions.explanation: A weight scales an input: bigger weight, bigger influence.

questions.text: Which layer receives the raw data?
questions.explanation: The input layer holds the raw feature values.

questions.text: Why do we use an activation function?
questions.explanation: Without it, stacked layers collapse into one straight-line function.

questions.text: What is the goal of training?
questions.explanation: Training adjusts weights so the loss becomes as small as possible.

questions.explanation: Sigmoid squashes large positive numbers towards 1.
